_notes: HTTPS is required by default. For an intentionally local/private plain-HTTP relay, set allowInsecureHttp to true; HTTP is then limited to localhost or a literal loopback/private/link-local address. Credentials and headers sent over HTTP are not encrypted.
baseUrl values must not contain URL userinfo (user:password@host). Put authentication in apiKey or headers instead, and avoid putting credentials in URL query parameters.

apiKey and header values follow Pi config-value syntax. Prefer $ENV_VAR. A leading !command deliberately runs a trusted local credential command as the Pi user; use $! for a literal leading exclamation mark, and never embed a secret in command text.
authHeader defaults to true only for openai-completions and openai-responses; set it explicitly for clarity or when a relay differs.
quotaRetry is opt-in and supported only for provider-level openai-completions. Use narrow temporary-error substrings; maxRetries defaults to 3 and baseDelayMs to 2000.
